name: ZED RUN GaslessReservoirEnabler whitelisted-token module allowance drain
summary: GaslessReservoirEnabler.erc20WithTransfersAndExecute lets anyone run caller-chosen calldata against any whitelisted module, while users hold standing token allowances to the enabler. After the admin whitelisted the WETH token itself as a module, anyone could make the enabler call WETH.transferFrom(victim, attacker) and spend every approver's allowance.
notes: moduleWhitelist[WETH] is a module grant (rule 8): non-whitelisted modules revert, and the deployment hours earlier left it false.

Campaign: the attacker's second WETH pass and its ZED-module pass, plus two later copycat txs from 0xb0fe6e9c. Selected from all WETH and ZED Approval logs with the enabler as spender where a Transfer left a holder other than the tx sender for an address other than the enabler, outside the relayer's meta-tx flow.
